text:
Mira: heads up — sampleapp using AsyncClient + token refresh hangs on shutdown for me.
Sam: hmm, reproducible for me too. what app config?
Mira: minimal repro: FastAPI app, global AsyncClient created in module scope, background task that calls /health which triggers automatic auth refresh on 401. on uvicorn reload or ctrl-c the process never exits.
Jonathan: can you paste the snippet?
Mira: sure:
```py
# client.py
from httpx import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()  # created at import

# main.py
from fastapi import FastAPI
from .client import client
app = FastAPI()

@app.get('/health')
async def health():
    r = await client.get('https://internal/auth-proxy')  # may 401 -> triggers token refresh logic
    return {'status': r.status_code}

# run with: uvicorn main:app --reload
```
Mira: stack shows asyncio tasks stuck waiting on `client._auth.refresh()` and shutdown waits for tasks to finish.
Andrea: are you using AsyncClient.aclose() in lifespan?
Mira: no, app leaves client open to reuse. we usually rely on program exit to close.
Sam: that leaks background tasks — but why deadlock? token refresh uses `asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete()` inside library auth code (sync refresh wrapped) — that seems wrong.
Jonathan: oh god, a sync call inside async using run_until_complete will blow up when loop already running. should raise RuntimeError, not hang. stack?
Mira: stack trace snippet: `Task got Future attached to a different loop`, then lots of ``await`` frames, finally `uvicorn.main` waiting for signals. no RuntimeError though, process just sits.
Andrea: could be an orphaned thread executor plus loop shutdown ordering. do you have patchy use of any `anyio` or `nest_asyncio`?
Mira: no, plain asyncio, httpx 0.24.x, python 3.11.
Sam: quick hack: call `await client.aclose()` in shutdown event — that makes uvicorn exit but still want to find root cause.
Mira: yep, workaround works. but onboarding docs don't mention "always close client on shutdown" for the sampleapps. new users will hit this frequently.
Jonathan: agree — we should either fix auth library to avoid run_until_complete when loop is running, or guard refresh with `if not asyncio.get_event_loop().is_running()` and use a background task otherwise.
Andrea: can you open a minimal GH issue with repro? I'll assign to eng-infra and mark p2.
Mira: created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapps/issues/128 — includes docker + uvicorn steps.
Sam: pinging @deploy-bot to check if our internal deploy helpers call any blocking refresh during lifecycle hooks.
deploy-bot: deployment-check: noticed `auth-sync-wrapper` in sampleapp image. Suggest replace with async-friendly refresh.
Jonathan: also add a note in SDK docs (async client section) that global AsyncClient imports can cause shutdown issues if auth hooks perform blocking ops. short-term doc PR would reduce onboarding friction.
Mira: filed doc PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devx-docs/pull/452 — adds a Lifespan section and sample `async def lifespan(app): client = AsyncClient(); try: yield; finally: await client.aclose()`
Andrea: nice. can we add an SDK linting rule or a devx warning in sampleapp scaffold to catch `AsyncClient()` at module scope?
Sam: we could add a CI job that greps for `AsyncClient()` usage outside lifespan/startup hooks and fail with suggestion.
Jonathan: or runtime debug mode that detects unclosed clients on shutdown and logs warnings with stack where created.
Mira: for now, the workaround + docs + GH issue should be enough. thanks all. :pray:
Sam: i'll follow up with a patch to the auth library to avoid run_until_complete. will link here.
Jonathan: thx — can we also add a tiny test to sampleapps that starts uvicorn and does ctrl-c to detect hangs? could be flaky but helpful.
Mira: added a TODO in the issue.
Andrea: closing loop: add changelog entry for SDK release notes about async auth incompatibility and recommended lifecycle pattern.
Mira: perfect, marking as resolved for the thread. :white_check_mark:
